eleven_fallacy_audit.evidence: AADM complete flight and ALFA raw flight are the independent units; processed clips inherit their raw-flight split.
SHA-256 flight-level splits were frozen before signal access.
The development replay selected no candidate; confirmation values were not used to change a heartbeat interval.
Both confirmation roles have access_count=1 and rerun is prohibited.
All preregistered intervals and all four N values are retained, including negative results.
The pooled Gilbert-Elliott proxy was not treated as stationary; flight-level heterogeneity and segment-level lag are reported separately.
Flight-cluster intervals, 0-to-0.8 rate range, and an overdispersion test accompany the pooled mean.
AADM uplink loss and ALFA FCU faults are not claimed to cause or equal semantic receiver-context loss.

Internal frame gaps are a lower-bound LoRa uplink proxy and do not calibrate ACK loss or exact semantic packet loss.
